description: Pages when a camera that still fires has dropped out of most of the motion its usual partner cameras keep recording. Staleness cannot see this: every stray event resets a camera's clock. cam_motion.py (partial_loss.py) tests every non-stale camera each poll: 48 h co-fire count against the 95% lower bound of a 27-day reference rate, binomial tail x partners < 1e-6, recent rate <= 1/3 of the bound, own event rate <= 2/3 of normal, no other partner whose co-fires contradict the loss (likelihood veto), hits lasting 30 min. It clears ONLY on evidence (partner back to >= half the frozen reference, improbable under the loss, for 6 h) - never with time; a deliberate change is silenced per flag with PARTIAL_LOSS_ACK in cam_motion.py. PUSH GATE (as camera_door_coverage_alert): on setchange or boot, only when a flagged camera's since stamp is under an hour old AND newer than this automation's last run, so a flag is normally paged once - including one entered by the startup poll (a re-assert landing in the seconds between a poll and its publish can swallow that push; the card still shows the flag) - and a restart, reload, timeout or monitor error that re-adds an already-flagged camera re-posts the card without re-paging; the 6-hourly re-assert only restores the card.

data.title: Partial motion loss: {{ (state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','partial_loss') or []) | join(', ') }}

conditions.value_template: {% set det = (state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','partial_detail') or {}).get('cams') or {} %}{% set lt = as_timestamp(this.attributes.last_triggered, 0) if this else 0 %}{% set ns = namespace(fresh=false) %}{% for c in (state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','partial_loss') or []) %}{% set s = ((det.get(c) or {}).get('since') or 0) | int(0) %}{% if s >= as_timestamp(now()) - 3600 and s > lt %}{% set ns.fresh = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ trigger.id in ['setchange', 'boot'] and ns.fresh }}
